stemMd: A retailer has 80 outlets. Fifty offer repair services and 45 offer equipment rental. Every outlet offers at least one of the two. Which conclusion follows?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Every rental outlet also offers repairs.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Thirty-five outlets offer rental but not repair.

explanationMd: Inclusion-exclusion gives overlap=50+45-80=15. Counting the two service groups separately counts shared outlets twice.

distractorRationale.c: Rental-only count is 45 minus the 15 overlap.
distractorRationale.e: Rental-only outlets number 30, not 35; 35 is the repair-only count.
distractorRationale.b: The group sizes and union require only 15 overlapping outlets.
